targeting.source: GOB 65 stores one selected enemy (CastDirectObjects 0, CastValidTarget 3), Hacker Style, TestFunction 2 and 20 m selection range. It applies both -24 resistance debuffs for 33 seconds.
targeting.runtime: The ordinary 80b9 path resolves the selected player through the range, sight and PvP rules before the shared viral contest, then scopes the landed change to that player.
targeting.test: The disposable ability-parity-hacker-hostile-upgrades fixture exercises the real selected hostile and tests separate allied and out-of-range refusals through the same admission path. FreeCastViralContestTests verifies each template enters the normal contest and the supported hit/deflect encoding.
